question: Do I need an SSL certificate?
answer: Yes, without exception. Browsers actively warn visitors that a site without HTTPS is "Not Secure", which destroys trust instantly regardless of how good the rest of the site is. SSL is also a confirmed (if minor) Google ranking factor, and most modern hosting providers now include free SSL certificates by default, so there's rarely a reason not to have one.
